an4.31:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these four wheels. When these four wheels turn, those devas and humans who possess them soon attain greatness and abundance of wealth.
an4.31:1.3: Dwelling in a suitable locality, relying on good persons, right resolution, and merits done in the past.
an4.31:1.4: These are the four wheels. When these four wheels turn, those devas and humans who possess them soon attain greatness and abundance of wealth.”
an4.31:2.1: When a person dwells in a suitable locality
an4.31:2.2: and makes friends with the noble ones,
an4.31:2.3: when he has formed right resolutions,
an4.31:2.4: and done deeds of merit in the past,
an4.31:2.6: along with happiness accrue to him.
